summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Best Start Time' chip on HourlyForecastSheet. All 5 checks PASS. Chip visible (testID hourly-best-chip), contains 'BEST START'. hourly-best-time = '18:00' matches ^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$. Chip text contains both '°F' and '%'. Best row (row-0, '18:00') has clearly different styling: border-left-width=3px + amber bg rgba(245,158,11,0.1) vs 0px + transparent for other rows. No 'unique key prop' / 'Each child' console warnings after opening the sheet (regression from iteration 12 remains fixed).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: best-row row text includes the Ionicons star glyph (\uf595) prepended, so 'text starts with best time' detection needs to strip icon glyphs. Not a bug — just something for future test scripts to be aware of.

bestChip is only rendered when bestPoint exists which requires points.length>0 — good. Scoring uses future+current hours indiscriminately; if backend already returns future 12 hours this is fine (confirmed by 18:00 being selected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Best Start chip verified. hourly-best-chip testID present; hourly-best-time testID renders HH:MM; row highlighting via border-left + amber background works. Ionicon star glyph is prepended inline to row text — future tests should detect best row via computed border-left-width or bg color rather than 'startsWith(bestTime)'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — new feature works end-to-end. Chip on screenshot shows '18:00 · 66°F · 1% · 4 mph · Warm & dry — ideal to start'. Row 0 in the compact list shows the amber left-border, amber '18:00' text, amber weather icon, and star badge.
